sloka: न कश्चिन्मलिनस्तत्र दीनो वा ऽप्यथ कृर्शतः ।तस्मिन्यज्ञवरे राज्ञो हृष्टपुष्टजनावृते ।। ७.९२.१३ ॥
transliteration: na kaścinmalinastatra dīno vā 'pyatha kṛrśataḥ ।tasminyajñavare rājño hṛṣṭapuṣṭajanāvṛte ।। 7.92.13 ॥

translations.english: In that excellent sacrifice of the king, which was filled with happy and well-nourished people, there was no one who was dirty, poor, or emaciated.
